%% Geometry deck: side footnotes in a standard frame (a strip along the right edge, below the title block).
\setSlideVersion{1-0-0}
\sidefootnotes
\begin{standardframe}{Side footnotes}
	\begin{itemize}
		\item A claim with a long side footnote\footnote{This side footnote is long enough to wrap onto a second line of the strip, so that the length of a strip line is measurable: a line is at most as long as the strip, and the longest one is close to it, unless a word does not fit.}
		\item Another claim
	\end{itemize}
\end{standardframe}
